scope: Surface-compensation follow-up only; unchanged Hamiltonian, N=2048, output grid and frozen scorer.
source: Byte-identical frozen VAMPIRE CMC with initialization/measurement wrapper.
gold: 17 angles, four independent aligned/hot/domain-x/domain-z starts, 20000 burn + 30000 production sweeps each.
midpoints: 16 interleaved angles, two independent hot/domain-z starts, 20000 burn + 30000 production sweeps each.
strong: 17 angles, two separate independent hot/domain-x starts, 40000 burn + 40000 production sweeps each.
reflection: Minus pi/4, two independent hot/domain-x starts, 20000 burn + 30000 production sweeps each.
sem: Maximum of between-chain SEM and within-chain block SEM with progressively larger groups through at least 5000 sweeps when available.
quadrature_check: Compare 17- and 33-angle composite Simpson integrals, accounting for their shared even-angle samples.
limits: Finite independent chains and block diagnostics are evidence, not a theorem of global mixing; no small-N oracle is substituted for large-system checks. A failed reference invalidates the candidate regardless of submitted score. Scout MBAR ESS is not a full-budget failure.
